description: This Java class 'PcChargeServices' provides payment processing services such as authorization, capture, release, and refund through the 'PcChargeApi' interface, integrating with a third-party payment gateway within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PcChargeServices
classes.description: A utility class providing payment transaction services such as authorization, capture, release, and refund via a third-party payment gateway API within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization, handling transaction setup, sending, and response processing.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Sets credit card details into the API object from the context.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Creates and configures a PcChargeApi instance based on provided properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for the payment gateway from entity properties.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats the transaction amount as a string with proper scale and rounding.
